Messages.Author: Emile Bosman
Messages.Body:
LSJ, are independent vampires with votes also prohibited from taking
the +1 stealth action to become an Anarch?

Emile
"We are an ape with a symbiotic relationship to a mushroom"

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>LSJ, are independent vampires with votes also prohibited from taking
>the +1 stealth action to become an Anarch?

Yes, Independent vampires with printed votes are titled, thus they canont take
the innate action to become an Anarch.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Any titled vampire, Camarilla, Sabbat, or Independent, is prohibited
from taking the action to become Anarch. That action is only available to
non-titled vampires.
